label: Plan accepted as proposed
criterion: Applies to every run where a task-size gauge was rendered and answered — never to a run that owed no gauge, so an exempt slash-command run cannot count as a miss. ✓ the user let the plan proceed as proposed · ✗ the user altered the scope or approach, or declined. A gate walked away from is excluded from both sides and reported as an abandoned count — silence is no verdict on a plan. A gate no judge could answer is likewise absent rather than guessed. Every gate is judged, including those the user answered by picking an option the gate offered: the judge weighs which option was chosen, because passing those through as acceptance would pin a tenth of the denominator at 100% by construction. The call is made by a model and cached per gate, so it reads intent rather than keywords; it is still a judgment, hence the heuristic tier.
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次曾渲染並被回答的任務量表——從不適用於本就不欠量表的執行，所以被豁免的斜線指令不會被算成一次失分。✓ 使用者讓計畫依原提案繼續進行 · ✗ 使用者更動了範圍或做法，或拒絕了提案。被晾在一旁、未獲回應的關卡會從分子分母中排除，另計為「放棄」的數量——沉默不代表對計畫的任何判決。模型判斷不出來的關卡同樣予以排除，而不是用猜的湊數。每一個關卡都會被判斷，包括使用者是從關卡提供的選項中挑一個作答的情況：判斷時會權衡選的是哪一個選項，因為若把這些一律算成接受，分母裡就有十分之一會結構性地固定在 100%。判決由模型做出、按每個關卡快取，因此讀的是意圖而非關鍵字；但終究仍是一種判斷，所以歸在啟發式這一級。

label: Bug reported against a prior completion within the same session
criterion: Pending — the bug-gate scorer is not built yet. When live: applies to every task segment that closed with plan.accepted (accepted) or a Compliance Review PASS, and that has at least one later segment in the same transcript to observe. ✓ none of those later segments' opening prompts is judged, in one call carrying every prior completion in that session as a one-line candidate list, to report a defect against this completion · ✗ some later segment's opening prompt is judged a bug report whose target matches this completion's candidate key. A report whose judged target matches no candidate in the list counts toward neither side — attribution must be certain, not assumed against the nearest prior completion. Judged once per (session, turn) and cached like plan.accepted, so a closed transcript is never re-judged.
label_zh: 同一 session 內，完成後被回報的錯誤
criterion_zh: 待建——bug-gate 的計分器還沒寫。上線後：適用於每一個以 plan.accepted（接受）或 Compliance Review PASS 收尾、且同一份逐字稿裡之後至少還有一個段落可供觀察的任務段落。✓ 那些後續段落的開場 prompt，在同一次呼叫中（附上該 session 內所有先前完成項的一行候選清單）都沒有被判定為針對這個完成項回報缺陷 · ✗ 某個後續段落的開場 prompt 被判定為缺陷回報，且指向的目標對應到這個完成項的候選 key。若判定出的目標對不上清單裡任何一個候選，這筆回報兩邊都不計入——歸屬必須是確定的，不能假設是指向最近一個先前完成項。跟 plan.accepted 一樣，以 (session, turn) 為 key 判斷一次並快取，已關閉的逐字稿不會被重新判斷。

label: Compliance Review closes clean, among the reviews actually run
criterion: Applies only to task segments (consecutive edits + read-only wind-down) that actually carried a review: a 'Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL' line follows the segment's last edit AND an Agent review was dispatched at or before it, for segments dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ that verdict reads PASS · ✗ it reads FAIL. A segment that closed with no verdict, or with one typed and no review agent spawned, counts toward neither side — a review never run is no verdict on the work — and is reported beneath the row as an excluded count, split into silent and explicitly skipped. This asks how sound the work was, not whether the ritual was performed; the segment fold is a heuristic, hence the tier.
label_zh: 已進行的審查中，以 PASS 收尾的比例
criterion_zh: 僅適用於真的進行過審查的任務段落（連續的修改加上其後的唯讀收尾）：「Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL」一行落在該段最後一次修改之後，且該行之前確有一次 Agent 審查被派出，日期於 2026-07-16 以後。✓ 該判決讀作 PASS · ✗ 讀作 FAIL。未以任何判決收尾的段落，或只打了標記卻未派出審查代理的段落，兩邊都不計入——未曾進行的審查，對成果不構成任何判決——而是在該列下方另記一筆排除數，分為靜默未審與明示略過。這一列問的是成果健不健全，而非儀式有沒有做；折段的判斷屬於啟發式，故歸在該層。
